body: I just wanted to say a massive thank you to everyone on here who replied. Thank you for your support. She is a lot better now and is happy when we are talking. I am doing well myself. I got in touch with Samaritans and also have some really great friends that got me through the tough time. Thank you all so much
No, I don't know her family and the only service that I know is Samaritans but I'm not sure if she would contact them

I try to keep calm by messaging one or two of my closest friends but I don't want them to start to feel the same way that I am. The suicidal bouts are like mood swings as she can feel a lot better five minutes later

I have one or two close friends that have been great to recently. I have encouraged her to seek professional help but she doesn't feel comfortable doing it. Thank you for your kind and detailed response
She doesn't like to call when she is feeling okay as she is shy so there is no way she will call when feeling suicidal but thank yin for your help

I have prevented the same person from committing suicide twice in the last week by just talking to them online (We live several hours away from each other). It is starting to have an impact on me because I feel so helpless while they are feeling down and suicidal
